jobPlans.purpose: Apply retention, archival, and queue cleanup policy.
jobPlans.activationGate: Exact eighteen-model guarded-policy marker; each scheduled run exits before any scan or mutation until enrollment completes.
jobPlans.downstreamApiLimits: Database writes must use cedros-pay:store-db and be batch-limited.
jobPlans.ownerVisibleOutcome: Deleted, archived, retained, and failed counts with retention window.

jobPlans.purpose: Aggregate the prior day's ledger into a daily stats-rollup summary row read by the stats route.
jobPlans.downstreamApiLimits: Reads and writes use cedros-pay:store-db; paginated and capped under the invocation deadline.
jobPlans.ownerVisibleOutcome: Day, transaction count, and gross total rolled up.

jobPlans.purpose: Reconcile provider subscription state into monotonic Pay projections.
jobPlans.activationGate: Exact eighteen-model guarded-policy marker; schedule remains default disabled.
jobPlans.downstreamApiLimits: Bounded Stripe reads and guarded database updates only.
jobPlans.ownerVisibleOutcome: Redacted checked, updated, expired, and retry counts.

jobPlans.purpose: Deliver durable webhook outbox items, canonical checkout settlement effects, and post-commit domain events, CRM source events, and customer-tag effects with fenced leases.
jobPlans.activationGate: Exact eighteen-model guarded-policy marker; the enabled schedule returns retryable before any outbox claim until enrollment completes.
jobPlans.downstreamApiLimits: Bounded allowlisted http.fetch webhook batch plus bounded host telemetry, CRM-source-event, and customer-tag effect batches.
jobPlans.ownerVisibleOutcome: Redacted delivered, deferred, retried, and failed webhook counts plus nested settlementEffects and domainEffects outcomes.

jobPlans.purpose: Reconcile durable pending x402 payments from on-chain proof.
jobPlans.activationGate: Exact eighteen-model guarded-policy marker; schedule remains default disabled.
jobPlans.downstreamApiLimits: Bounded Solana RPC status reads and guarded settlement writes.
jobPlans.ownerVisibleOutcome: Redacted pending, settled, failed, and retry counts.

jobPlans.purpose: Automatically reconcile active purchasable catalog products and prices to Stripe.
jobPlans.activationGate: Exact eighteen-model guarded-policy marker; Stripe enabled and secret configured.
jobPlans.downstreamApiLimits: 50 catalog rows and at most 5 products per invocation; 90 second product budget; daily provider revalidation.
jobPlans.ownerVisibleOutcome: Redacted checked, synced, failed, deferred counts and per-product sync status.
